status: Pre-registered before implementation or evaluation of NFL model outputs
objective: Originate reproducible NFL research lines and test probabilistic skill. No claim of sportsbook profitability without executable prices.

data.development: 2025 weeks 1–5 initialize form and the online rest coefficient; never counted as holdout.
data.evaluation: 2025 week 6 through 2026 week 8, in chronological whole-week blocks. Only earlier games update ratings.
data.venue: No home/away assignment is inferred from listing order. No home-field coefficient is used. The upcoming game's venue alone is officially confirmed.
data.missing: Missing player statistics remain missing; no zero filling or complete-case imputation.

fixed_parameters.score_distribution: Independent Poisson team scores, integer grid 0..100; explicitly a model assumption, not an official NFL distribution.

line_definitions.team_a_spread: Half-integer handicap minimizing absolute distance of modeled cover probability to 0.5; tie chooses the smaller threshold.
line_definitions.total: Half-integer threshold minimizing absolute distance of modeled over probability to 0.5; tie chooses the smaller threshold.
line_definitions.moneyline: Own win-share probability P(win)+0.5*P(tie); fair decimal odds=1/p. This is a project draw-half convention, NOT a verified sportsbook settlement rule.
line_definitions.cross_game_parlay: Two eligible favorite outright-win legs in the same season-week, sorted by official game ID and paired deterministically. Leg p=P(outright win); a tied game is a lost leg for this research event, not a claimed sportsbook settlement. Joint p=p1*p2+rho*sqrt(p1*(1-p1)*p2*(1-p2)), clipped to Frechet bounds. Rho uses only earlier weeks.
line_definitions.same_game_combo: Spread/total joint probability is summed over the same Poisson score grid, never multiplied as if independent. Model-implied dependence is not an empirical sportsbook correlation.
line_definitions.player_prop: Half-integer line nearest the empirical median of observed 2026 regular-season values. Descriptive only; no availability or market-edge claim.
line_definitions.player_combo: Same-player receptions and receiving-yard thresholds are evaluated on paired observed games. Cross-player same-game dependence is left blank without paired observations.

primary_trial_family: M2 win-share Brier improvement vs M1
M4 win-share Brier improvement vs M1
M2 margin MSE improvement vs M1
M4 margin MSE improvement vs M1
M2 total MSE improvement vs M1
M4 total MSE improvement vs M1
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across all six primary trials. M3, threshold sensitivity, correlations and parlay experiments are exploratory and cannot earn rewards.
uncertainty: Seeded percentile bootstrap resamples entire season-weeks. Primary skill null uses whole-week sign-flip permutations. These reduce, but cannot eliminate, luck; exchangeability and limited-cluster assumptions remain.

gates.name: Official input integrity
gates.rule: Every input observation has an official source; season game totals reconcile to official W/L/T/PF/PA; no missing-value fill.

gates.name: Temporal isolation
gates.rule: All features use earlier games only; changing future outcomes must not change an earlier prediction.

gates.name: Effective sample
gates.rule: Singles: at least 300 games and 20 season-weeks. Parlays: at least 150 tickets and 20 weeks. Each player market: at least 100 observed player-games. Thresholds are project policy, not NFL facts.

gates.name: Skill vs baseline
gates.rule: Paired week-bootstrap 95% lower bound for relevant loss improvement > 0 and Holm-adjusted primary permutation p < 0.05.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: For the relevant market (win-share, own-spread cover, or own-total over), equal-frequency five-bin ECE <= 0.04; no bin with at least 20 observations may have absolute predicted/observed gap > 0.10. Project policy.

gates.name: Repeatability
gates.rule: Relevant loss improvement > 0 in both 2025 and 2026 evaluation blocks and after leaving out any one season-week.

gates.name: Dependence control
gates.rule: Parlay joint model must beat an independent-product model on paired week-bootstrap Brier improvement with lower bound > 0; same-game and player combos require empirical paired validation, not a model-only coefficient.

gates.name: Executable market edge
gates.rule: Timestamped sportsbook prices, settlement/void rules and de-vigged probabilities; net ROI after vig with week-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and positive closing-line value. Missing inputs block this gate.

gates.name: Availability and operational controls
gates.rule: Point-in-time injury/lineup information, active roster, market limits and void/dead-heat rules verified before every selection. Current profile status alone is insufficient.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.rule: At least 100 future selections locked before kickoff under this frozen protocol, with positive lower-bound net ROI and no post-hoc redesign.

gates.name: Multiplicity and null control
gates.rule: All primary trials accounted for; Holm correction and dependence-aware null test executed. Exploratory variants cannot displace primary results.

gates.name: Reward governance
gates.rule: Only non-monetary badges; no entry fee, stake, cash prize or profit promise. A badge requires every applicable gate; blocked is not passed.

leaderboard.eligible_rank_metric: Lower 95% week-bootstrap bound of net ROI after vig, only after all gates pass.
leaderboard.research_display: Show measured probability loss and sample size separately; never label it betting ROI.

rewards.Silver: All retrospective gates; prospective replication pending; no reward
rewards.Research only: Any failed or blocked gate; no reward

leaderboard.tie_break: No eligible strategies means no ranking and no reward; do not manufacture a winner.

disclosures: No sportsbook odds archive or executable price feed was verified. All market odds, CLV, ROI and market-edge fields remain blank.
Official schedule excerpts were read through the research tool; bash/CI cannot access NFL hosts. This is a verified snapshot, not an automatic live feed.
The points-only model omits quarterback changes, injuries, weather, roster strength, pace, EPA and venue. It is a baseline, not a production pricing engine.
Independent Poisson scores and draw-half moneylines are modeling conventions. Actual NFL scoring and book settlement differ.
Player logs are small and some cells are blank. Same-player correlation is mechanically related and not evidence of a profitable sportsbook prop.
Luck cannot be removed completely. The gates control leakage, selection, dependence and multiple testing; they do not guarantee future profits.
